profile.name: Sudheer Kumar Gupta
profile.headline: I build backends that stay fast and correct under load, and I pick up whatever stack the problem needs.
summary: Five years of building and running backend systems: Java / Spring Boot and Node.js / NestJS services on PostgreSQL and MySQL, shipped with Docker, Kubernetes and AWS. That includes a platform serving 10,000+ concurrent users.
I work AI-augmented. I use Claude Code every day to move faster, and I verify every change with tests before it ships.
I'm happiest on the hard problems: a slow query, a leaky auth boundary, a flaky deploy.
profile.eligibility: Authorized to work in India and Thailand · no visa sponsorship needed
profile.education: B.Tech, Computer Science & Engineering, Vel Tech R&D Institute, Chennai (2017–2021), CGPA 8.23
publications: Mushroom edibility classification with dimensionality reduction (ICICCT 2021)
Undersampling-aware learning for fetal health prediction (TOJQI)

experience.title: Infra Managed Service Analyst, Backend & Automation
highlights: Built API automation on Microsoft Graph (OAuth2 client credentials, paging, $batch, throttling-aware retries) that removed 75% of manual operations work across enterprise Microsoft 365 tenants.
Ran multi-terabyte migrations with structured validation and change management, with zero data loss.
L2/L3 production support and root-cause analysis with 100% SLA compliance.

experience.title: Backend Engineer
highlights: Designed and shipped a B2B client platform solo: NestJS + TypeScript APIs, a React front end and MySQL, deployed with Docker and Nginx.
Split authentication into its own service, which cut coupling by 60%. Added a versioned partner API with API keys, HMAC-signed webhooks and Swagger docs.
20+ targeted MySQL indexes and caching brought APIs under 100 ms. A CMS with version history made content work 90% faster.
Docker multi-stage builds took deploys from 20 minutes to 3.

experience.title: Application Development Associate
highlights: Built Spring Boot microservices on Kubernetes serving 10,000+ concurrent users.
Made APIs 75–80% faster with PostgreSQL indexing, query rewrites and Redis caching.
Moved document processing off the request path with Kafka/RabbitMQ and S3. Added Azure DevOps CI/CD and Spring Security JWT with RBAC.

projects.name: This page: a backend in your browser
projects.summary: A Service Worker acts as the HTTP server and PostgreSQL runs as WebAssembly. Together they serve this page's content, plus a task API with JWT login and Postgres row-level security. Every request is real, and you can inspect it in DevTools.
highlights: Real HTTP via a Service Worker
Real Postgres: RLS, full-text search, EXPLAIN ANALYZE
Falls back gracefully when the browser can't run it

projects.name: Secure multi-tenant task API
projects.summary: A Spring Boot REST API where every user sees only their own data. It has JWT + RBAC, tenant-scoped queries (404 across tenants), optimistic locking (409), token-bucket rate limiting (429) and request IDs, with 20 integration tests and CI on every push.
highlights: No password hashes ever leave the API

projects.name: JOB-HUNT: a job portal, security-hardened
projects.summary: My 2020 PHP job board, revisited as a security exercise. I fixed SQL injection, remote code execution through uploads, broken access control between roles, CSRF and XSS, then proved the fixes with 43 end-to-end tests.
highlights: Role and ownership checks enforced in SQL

projects.name: Buddy Hub: restaurant ordering system
projects.summary: In production on Firebase. Customers order by scanning a per-table QR code, and the kitchen display, billing counter and admin panel update in real time. Staff have separate roles, and table sessions are claimed inside transactions so two customers can't grab the same table.
highlights: Optional GST handled consistently from cart to CSV

projects.name: Goonj Foundation: civic sense & donations
projects.summary: A bilingual (English/Hindi) app for a rural-development NGO, with 137 illustrated civic-sense topics, campaign progress, impact stats, stories and donations. Donors get PDF certificates generated on the server.

projects.name: Video-based human authentication
projects.summary: A gate access logger that recognizes enrolled people from a live webcam and records who entered and when, using OpenCV Haar-cascade detection and an LBPH recognizer. It was published as a research paper, and I later revived it to run on current Python and OpenCV.

projects.name: Real-time multiplayer Tic-Tac-Toe
projects.summary: Two players on different phones play the same board. PubNub channels carry the lobby, the moves and rematch messages, and presence checks stop a third player joining a full room.

projects.name: WUS/KUS mobile app
projects.summary: The foundation of a mobile app on Expo SDK 54 and React Native 0.81 with the New Architecture. One codebase builds separate development, pre-production and production apps.

projects.name: Turrican 2 prototype
projects.summary: A 2D platformer prototype built in four days to learn Unity. It covers physics-based movement and jumping, ground detection and an animator state machine.

strengths.title: AI-augmented, not AI-dependent
strengths.body: Claude Code is part of my daily workflow for building, debugging and reviewing, and it makes me faster. I stay the engineer: I read the diff, I write the test, I own the result. This site and the JOB-HUNT hardening were both built that way.

strengths.title: A fast learner
strengths.body: I went from zero to production Microsoft Graph automation in weeks. I picked up Go, Unity and React Native for projects that needed them. New stacks don't scare me, and unfamiliar codebases are just puzzles.

strengths.title: A problem solver
strengths.body: I like the bugs nobody wants: an auth filter that returned 500s, tenant data leaking through a 403, an upload path that allowed code execution. I find it, prove it with a test, and fix it so it stays fixed.
